Question 17
?

The graph shows a portion of the curve y=tan⁡x and y=−1. Which of the following generates the x-values of all of their points of intersection? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=π2+nπ
b
x=−π4+nπ
c
x=−π3+nπ
d
x=π4+nπ
e
x=−π4+2nπ
